0022600097.text: The Wizards, 1-0 and second in the Southeast, host the Toronto Raptors for their second game of the season, with Washington sitting 4th in the East after opening with a win at home. The Raptors open their 2026-27 season, and the two teams have not met yet this season, though Toronto took the 2025-26 series 2-1 and beat Washington 134-125 in Washington on February 28, 2026. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot).
